india.one_line: India targets AI application leadership as Sarvam and Coforge launch new enterprise models and tools.

themes.title: India targets AI application leadership
themes.text: Union Electronics and Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that India is focused on becoming the artificial intelligence application capital of the world.

stories.headline: India focused on becoming AI application capital of the world: Ashwini Vaishnaw

themes.title: Sarvam launches Prism decision model
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Prism, an open-weight decision model built on its Sarvam 105B foundation model for enterprise workflows.

stories.headline: Sarvam launches Prism open-weight decision model built on Sarvam 105B

themes.title: Coforge joins SpaceX partner network
themes.text: Coforge Limited joined the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network to deploy Grok AI tools for enterprise clients.

stories.headline: Coforge joins SpaceX partner network to deploy Grok for clients
